title: 🚨 IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT 🚨
body:
In case you haven’t already seen the news in the messenger or discord chats, today it was confirmed that World Fantasy Soccer will be finishing up effective immediately. Unfortunately as it stands right now this leaves the A-League without any sort of fantasy platform for the upcoming season

We remain hopeful a new website appears but in the event this doesn’t happen, the more tech savvy brains of the Eliza are investigating possible options for next season, these include an AI made website or (while not ideal) utilisation of Google programs to submit teams week to week

The Eliza Cup has been through a difficult last few years with constant platform changes but has proven to be very resilient and adaptable. Rest assured there WILL be an Eliza Cup this year

🐘 ELIZA FOREVER 🐘

title: 🚨  FANTASY PLATFORM UPDATE 🚨
body:
After the sudden closure of World Fantasy Soccer last month, we are happy to report that a new platform is currently being worked on thanks to the amazing work of some users from both the Eliza and A-League Reddit communities

At this stage there isn't a concrete opening date but things are going ahead of schedule so stay tuned for more information as it comes

🐘 ELIZA FOREVER 🐘
